rules.title: General Laws Chapter 40P, Section 4 – General prohibition; exception
rules.requirement: Bars cities and towns from enacting, maintaining or enforcing rent control of any kind, except that a municipality accepting the chapter may adopt voluntary rent control that excludes units owned by owners of fewer than ten units or with fair market rent over $400, cannot regulate occupancy, services, evictions or condominium conversion, and must compensate owners from general funds for the difference between fair market rent and the controlled rent.
rules.key_value: Rent control banned; limited exception: owner compliance voluntary after 6 months, units with fair market rent up to $400, owners of 10+ units, municipality compensates owners
rules.status_basis: Section appears in the General Laws of Massachusetts; enactment date not stated in the text.

coverage.summary: Applies to rent control by any city or town in Massachusetts.

precedence.text: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind, except that any city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation that provides:
